Hidden transfer: Depreciation Fund shows 700,000 transferred from the General Fund (p15); the General Fund budget schedule (p13) includes it inside the Operation and maintenance of plant lines, and the General Fund Components schedule (p7) shows it in a reclassification column; recorded with a contra expenditure line -700,000 and an other financing line -700,000.
